# ISA reference (v0.1)

<!-- generated by isa/isa.py from isa/isa.yaml; do not edit -->

Generated from `isa/isa.yaml`; the programming model is in [isa.md](isa.md). Every instruction is one 128-bit word with the opcode in bits [127:120].

## Front end

| Opcode | Name | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `NOP` | S_NONE | No operation. |
| 0x01 | `HALT` | S_NONE | Wait until every queue is empty and every write is acknowledged, then stop and raise the done interrupt. |
| 0x02 | `FENCE` | S_FENCE | Stall the front end until the queues in qmask are empty and their writes are acknowledged. |
| 0x03 | `IRQ` | S_IRQ | Send an interrupt with code imm to the command processor. |
| 0x08 | `LI` | S_RI | R[rd] = imm (64-bit). |
| 0x09 | `ADD` | S_RRR | R[rd] = R[rs1] + R[rs2]. |
| 0x0A | `ADDI` | S_RRI | R[rd] = R[rs1] + imm. |
| 0x0B | `SUB` | S_RRR | R[rd] = R[rs1] - R[rs2]. |
| 0x0C | `MUL` | S_RRR | R[rd] = low 64 bits of R[rs1] * R[rs2]. |
| 0x0D | `MULI` | S_RRI | R[rd] = low 64 bits of R[rs1] * imm. |
| 0x0E | `AND` | S_RRR | R[rd] = R[rs1] & R[rs2]. |
| 0x0F | `ANDI` | S_RRI | R[rd] = R[rs1] & imm. |
| 0x10 | `OR` | S_RRR | R[rd] = R[rs1] \| R[rs2]. |
| 0x11 | `XOR` | S_RRR | R[rd] = R[rs1] ^ R[rs2]. |
| 0x12 | `SHLI` | S_RRI | R[rd] = R[rs1] << imm[5:0]. |
| 0x13 | `SHRI` | S_RRI | R[rd] = R[rs1] >> imm[5:0] (logical). |
| 0x14 | `SRAI` | S_RRI | R[rd] = R[rs1] >> imm[5:0] (arithmetic). |
| 0x15 | `MIN` | S_RRR | R[rd] = min(R[rs1], R[rs2]) (signed). |
| 0x16 | `MAX` | S_RRR | R[rd] = max(R[rs1], R[rs2]) (signed). |
| 0x18 | `BEQ` | S_BR | If R[rs1] == R[rs2], PC += imm. |
| 0x19 | `BNE` | S_BR | If R[rs1] != R[rs2], PC += imm. |
| 0x1A | `BLT` | S_BR | If R[rs1] < R[rs2] (signed), PC += imm. |
| 0x1B | `BGE` | S_BR | If R[rs1] >= R[rs2] (signed), PC += imm. |
| 0x1C | `BLTU` | S_BR | If R[rs1] < R[rs2] (unsigned), PC += imm. |
| 0x20 | `LD` | S_MEM | R[rd] = SPM[R[rs1] + imm]; size: 0 = 8 B, 1 = 4 B signed, 2 = 4 B unsigned, 3 = 2 B unsigned, 4 = 1 B unsigned. Not ordered against queued instructions: wait on a semaphore first. |
| 0x21 | `ST` | S_MEM | SPM[R[rs1] + imm] = R[rs2] (size as LD). |
| 0x24 | `CSRR` | S_CSR | R[rd] = CSR[csr]. |
| 0x25 | `CSRW` | S_CSR | CSR[csr] = R[rs1]. |
| 0x28 | `SWAIT` | S_SEM | Stall the front end until sem[sem] >= R[rs1] + imm (unsigned 32-bit compare). |
| 0x29 | `SSET` | S_SEM | sem[sem] = R[rs1] + imm. Only legal while no queued instruction references sem. |
| 0x2A | `SINC` | S_SEM | sem[sem] += R[rs1] + imm, in program order with respect to the front end only. |

## DMA (queue DQ0-DQ3 from the dq field)

| Opcode | Name | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x40 | `DMA_COPY` | T_DMA | Copy the tile described by (src_reg, src_td) to (dst_reg, dst_td), converting with cvt and writing with wop. Shapes must have the same element count; the destination TD sets the order. n_reg != 0 overrides the outermost count of both TDs. At most one operand may be GLOBAL (else TD_SPACE): the other is local (SPM, DTAB, IMEM), so read data always sinks locally (noc.md section 4 rule 2). At most one TD may be PAGED; its row (dim 1) is translated through the page table at SPM[R[pt_reg]] and its base register is a paged pointer (memmap.md section 6). Block formats: scales of a non-paged operand are at R[scale_reg] with row stride TD aux0; a PAGED operand's scales are in the scale region of the same page. ts_reg: FP32 NVFP4 tensor scale in bits 31:0 (R0 = 1.0). FP8-target conversions write FP32 column scales to SPM[R[aux_reg]]. rsem != 0: every packet adds its payload bytes to sem[rsem] of the core that owns the destination address once the data is written. |
| 0x41 | `DMA_GATHER` | T_DMA | Row gather. src TD row_bytes = row size (any size, no alignment needed); the index list (int32 or int64 per IDX64) is at SPM[R[idx_reg]] with count from the dst TD outer dims or n_reg. Row i of the destination = source row index[i] (base = src_reg, row pitch = src TD s1). PAGED src: index[i] + the paged pointer's row is a logical row translated through the page table at SPM[R[pt_reg]]; block scales come from the same page. Operand spaces, conversions and scale operands as DMA_COPY (MXFP8 rows with SCALE_INLINE). Keeps up to dma_outstanding_reads granules in flight. |
| 0x42 | `DMA_SCATTER` | T_DMA | Row scatter: source row i goes to destination row index[i]; wop applies (ADD_F32 for MoE combine into SRAM). Operand spaces as DMA_COPY; PAGED dst as DMA_GATHER's src. |
| 0x43 | `DMA_MCAST` | T_DMAMC | Copy a local SPM tile to the same SPM offset (dst_reg, dst_td) in every core of the mesh rectangle x0..x1, y0..y1 of this die (XY-tree multicast in the network). rsem applies at each destination. |
| 0x44 | `DMA_LIST` | T_DMAL | Execute R[n_reg] + imm DMA descriptors stored back to back at SPM[R[list_reg]] (each 32 B: an encoded DMA_COPY/GATHER/SCATTER/MCAST/SIGNAL operand block with absolute addresses instead of registers). Used for collective schedules and other precomputed transfer lists. Completion = all listed transfers complete. |
| 0x45 | `SIGNAL` | T_SIG | After every earlier instruction in this DMA queue has completed (writes acknowledged), write to the semaphore at global address R[addr_reg]: mode 0 adds R[val_reg] + imm, mode 1 sets it. Release semantics for producer/consumer hand-off across cores, dies and packages. |

## MXU

| Opcode | Name | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x60 | `MXU_MM` | T_MXU | ACC(acc_reg) (+)= A x W. A = (a_reg, a_td) in SPM: M rows (a_td n1, or R[m_reg] when m_reg != 0) by K (a_td n0). W = (w_reg, w_td) in SPM: K x N, or N x K when trans_w = 1 (the HF [out, in] layout). The MXU loops over 64-column N tiles and K tiles (256 FP8 or 128 BF16 deep) internally; N tile j lands in ACC rows acc + j*M .. acc + j*M + M - 1. acc_mode OVERWRITE / ACCUM / RESCALE (rowscale FP32 [M] at SPM[rs_reg]). cs_reg != 0: column scales FP32 [K tiles x N] at SPM[cs_reg] multiply each K tile's partial sum before it is accumulated (block-scaled weights). mode BF16X3 emulates FP32 with three BF16 passes. |

## VPU / SFU / top-k

| Opcode | Name | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x80 | `VEW` | T_VPU | Element-wise d = func(s0, s1, s2) over the shape of d_td; sources broadcast through zero strides. p_reg holds two FP32 parameters (a in bits 31:0, b in bits 63:32). `func` = `vew_func`. |
| 0x81 | `VRED` | T_VPU | Reduction of s0 along dim 0 (axis 0) or dim 1 (axis 1). group != 0 reduces groups of `group` elements instead of the whole axis (e.g. Step 5 8-token region pooling). WSUM_RELU uses weights s1. `func` = `vred_func`. imm: `axis` [0:0], `group` [16:1]. |
| 0x82 | `VSCAN` | T_VPU | Prefix scan of s0 along the axis (linear-attention decay products, MoE offsets). `func` = `vscan_func`. imm: `exclusive` [0:0], `axis` [1:1]. |
| 0x83 | `VNORM` | T_VPU | Row normalization of s0 with gain s1 (and bias s2 for LAYER); eps = FP32 in p_reg bits 31:0. RMS_GROUPED normalizes each group of `group` elements; RMS_STAT writes rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) only. `func` = `norm_func`. imm: `group` [15:0]. |
| 0x84 | `VROPE` | T_VPU | Rotary embedding on the first rot_dims of each row of s0 with cos = s1, sin = s2 tables ([tokens x rot_dims/2], gathered by position beforehand); rows_per_token rows share one table row. `func` = `rope_mode`. imm: `rot_dims` [9:0], `rows_per_token` [17:10]. |
| 0x85 | `VSOFTMAX` | T_VPU | One online-softmax step (FlashAttention). s0 = scores [R x C] (ACC or SPM, FP32); s1 = state, three FP32 arrays m[R], l[R], alpha[R] back to back; d = P [R x C] (E4M3 or BF16). p_reg = (scale FP32, window int32), p2_reg = (query position of row 0 int32, key position of column 0 int32). Updates m and l, writes alpha = exp(m_old - m_new) for MXU_MM RESCALE. softcap = 1 applies c*tanh(s/c) with c from the TD aux0. `func` = `mask_mode`. imm: `rows_per_token` [7:0], `softcap` [8:8]. |
| 0x86 | `VQUANT` | T_VPU | Quantize s0 into d (packed elements) and s1 (scales); p_reg = tensor scale (NVFP4, E4M3_TENSOR). KV-cache writes and dynamic FP8 activations. `func` = `quant_fmt`. |
| 0x87 | `VTOPK` | T_VPU | Streaming top-k per row: merges the scores s0 [R x C] into the running state d (values FP32 [R x k] then indices int32 [R x k]). Column c has index p2_reg + c. init clears the state; final sorts it descending. Ties keep the lower index. BLOCKMAX: block size in p_reg bits 31:0. `func` = `topk_mode`. imm: `k` [11:0], `init` [12:12], `final` [13:13]. |
| 0x88 | `VROUTE` | T_VPU | MoE router: s0 = logits [T x E] FP32, s1 = correction bias [E]. score = func(logit); selection uses score + bias; group-limited selection keeps the topk_group best of n_group groups (group score = sum of its top-2); weights = score of the selected experts, normalized when norm = 1, times routed_scale (p_reg FP32). d = expert ids int32 [T x k] then weights FP32 [T x k]. `func` = `route_score`. imm: `k` [5:0], `n_group` [11:6], `topk_group` [17:12], `bias` [18:18], `norm` [19:19]. |
| 0x89 | `VBUCKET` | T_VPU | Counting sort of int32 ids s0 [N]: d = counts [n_bins], s1 = exclusive offsets [n_bins + 1], s2 = permutation [N] (positions sorted by id, stable). MoE dispatch lists. imm: `n_bins` [12:0]. |
| 0x8A | `VXPOSE` | T_VPU | d = transpose of the 2-D tile s0 (1, 2 or 4-byte elements). |
| 0x8B | `VMATVEC` | T_VPU | d [R x N] = s0 [R x K] x s1 [K x N] in FP32 on the VPU, N <= 32 (exact FP32 hyper-connection mixer). |
| 0x8C | `VTRINV` | T_VPU | d = (I + A)^-1 (or (I - A)^-1 when negate) for the strictly lower-triangular FP32 block A = s0, n <= 64 (chunked DeltaNet / KDA WY form). imm: `n` [6:0], `negate` [7:7]. |
| 0x90 | `HC_MIX` | T_VPU | mHC coefficients: s0 = projection [T x (2n + n^2)] FP32, s1 = rsqrt stat [T], s2 = parameters (alpha_pre, alpha_post, alpha_res, then bias [2n + n^2]). d = pre = sigmoid(.) + eps, post = 2*sigmoid(.), comb logits = alpha_res * m + bias; eps in p_reg. imm: `n_streams` [3:0]. |
| 0x91 | `HC_SINKHORN` | T_VPU | Row-softmax start then `iters` alternating row/column normalizations of each n x n block of s0 (in place allowed); eps in p_reg. imm: `iters` [7:0], `n_streams` [11:8]. |
| 0x92 | `HC_PRE` | T_VPU | d [T x D] = sum_i s1[T, i] * s0[T, i, D] (mHC collapse). mean = 1: d = mean_i sigmoid(s1[T, i, D]) * s0[T, i, D] with element-wise gate logits s1 [T x n x D] (Qwen gated HC). imm: `n_streams` [3:0], `mean` [4:4]. |
| 0x93 | `HC_POST` | T_VPU | Residual update of the n streams: s0 = sublayer output y [T x D], s1 = streams x [T x n x D], s2 = coefficients (MHC: the HC_MIX row with post and Sinkhorn comb; GATED: g [T x n]). d = new streams. `func` = `hc_post_func`. imm: `n_streams` [3:0]. |

## Enumerations

- `dtype`: FP32 = 0, BF16 = 1, FP16 = 2, E4M3 = 3, E5M2 = 4, MXFP8 = 5, MXFP4 = 6, NVFP4 = 7, INT8 = 8, UINT8 = 9, INT16 = 10, INT32 = 11, INT64 = 12, E8M0 = 13, UINT32 = 14
- `space`: GLOBAL = 0, SPM = 1, ACC = 2, DTAB = 3, IMEM = 4
- `td_flags`: PAGED = 0, IDX64 = 1, WRAP = 2, SCALE_INLINE = 3, SCALE_REGION = 4
- `cvt`: NONE = 0, MXFP4_E4M3 = 1, NVFP4_E4M3 = 2, MXFP8_E4M3 = 3, MXFP4_BF16 = 4, NVFP4_BF16 = 5, MXFP8_BF16 = 6, E4M3_BF16 = 7, E5M2_BF16 = 8, BF16_FP32 = 9, FP32_BF16 = 10
- `wop`: WRITE = 0, ADD_F32 = 1, ADD_BF16 = 2, MAX_F32 = 3
- `acc_mode`: OVERWRITE = 0, ACCUM = 1, RESCALE = 2
- `mxu_mode`: NORMAL = 0, BF16X3 = 1
- `vew_func`: COPY = 0, NEG = 1, ABS = 2, EXP = 3, EXP2 = 4, LOG = 5, RECIP = 6, RSQRT = 7, SQRT = 8, SIGMOID = 9, SILU = 10, SOFTPLUS = 11, TANH = 12, GELU_TANH = 13, RELU = 14, SQUARE = 15, SSQRT = 16, SQRTSOFTPLUS = 17, ADD = 32, SUB = 33, MUL = 34, DIV = 35, MAX = 36, MIN = 37, AXPBY = 38, AXPB = 39, SWIGLU = 40, SWIGLU_OAI = 41, CMP_LT = 42, FMA = 48, SELECT = 49, IADD = 64, ISUB = 65, IMUL = 66, ISHR = 67, ISHL = 68, IAND = 69, IMIN = 70, IMAX = 71
- `vred_func`: SUM = 0, MAX = 1, MIN = 2, SUMSQ = 3, MEAN = 4, AMAX = 5, ARGMAX = 6, ARGMIN = 7, LOGSUMEXP = 8, WSUM_RELU = 9
- `vscan_func`: CUMSUM = 0, CUMPROD = 1, LOGCUMSUMEXP = 2
- `norm_func`: RMS = 0, LAYER = 1, RMS_GROUPED = 2, RMS_STAT = 3
- `rope_mode`: HALF = 0, INTERLEAVED = 1
- `mask_mode`: NONE = 0, CAUSAL = 1, WINDOW = 2
- `topk_mode`: PLAIN = 0, BLOCKMAX = 1
- `route_score`: SOFTMAX = 0, SIGMOID = 1, SQRTSOFTPLUS = 2
- `quant_fmt`: E4M3_ROW = 0, MXFP8 = 1, MXFP4 = 2, NVFP4 = 3, E4M3_TENSOR = 4
- `hc_post_func`: MHC = 0, GATED = 1
- `csr`: CORE_ID = 0, NODE_ID = 1, CYCLE = 2, PC = 3, STATUS = 4, FAULT_CAUSE = 5, FAULT_ADDR = 6, FP_STATUS = 7, PERF_SEL = 16, PERF_CNT0 = 17, PERF_CNT1 = 18, SEM_BASE_GPA = 32
- `fault_cause`: NONE = 0, ILLEGAL_OP = 1, ILLEGAL_FIELD = 2, TD_SPACE = 3, ADDR_UNMAPPED = 4, ADDR_FORBIDDEN = 5, RAIL = 6, RANGE = 7, HBM_WADD = 8, HBM_ALIGN = 9, SEM_BUSY = 10, PTE_INVALID = 11, LINK = 12, ERR_RSP = 13
